title: What Vana keeps of a conversation

steps.label:
Notes saved as they happen
silent unless the athlete asked

Older messages fold into a summary
kept on the conversation

Server answers at once,
writes the one-sentence summary after

Next close summarises again
the latest summary wins

LAST TALKS line: what they said,
not their schedule

example: 61 messages replay as one summary plus 21 messages verbatim
Context block capped at 1,500 estimated tokens
